# Vendor packages (CI)

`me.autotouch.autotouch.ios8.inputtext_8.0.11_iphoneos-arm64.deb` is the **official** AutoTouch 8.0.11 inputtext arm64 package, used only on GitHub Actions to produce the hybrid patched release. Install the output from [Releases](https://github.com/smartmaster35rus-dev/autotouch-patch/releases), not this raw file directly.
